# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC23 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC23 adds an in-editor generated Keymap Reference so the iPad/Blink shortcut contract can be inspected without relying on a stale hand-maintained help table.

- `Esc ?` opens Keymap Reference.
- `:keys`, `:keymap`, `:shortcuts`, and `:bindings` open the same view.
- `Esc h` remains the compact static help screen.
- Keymap Reference is generated from `keymap::COMMANDS`.
- It groups commands by Core, Workspace, Code, Tasks, and Version Control.
- Each entry shows the action-layer sequence, command title, stable command ID, and palette keywords.
- The footer hints were updated to expose `?`, `w E`, and `t d`.
- The view is read-only and cannot edit source text.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
